title: The WalkUp: a bar that's easy to find, one flight up
tag: Cocktail bar, Cary, NC · Launching Nov 2026
summaryLead: A site for the cocktail bar above happy's in downtown Cary: a seasonal menu you can tap through, the room in real photos, and a clear way upstairs.
story: The WalkUp sits one flight above happy's, and people walk past the door without knowing it's there. The site starts with that: "A little above the usual," the address, and "upstairs, above Happy's" right under the headline. The menu is the Fall / Winter 2026 list. Tap a drink to add it to a tab you use to plan the round, since everyone orders at the counter, or tap a glass to see what's in it. Photos of the exposed brick, timber beams and plants show the room. The site also links across to happy's, because that's how most people arrive.
goals: Tell first-timers the bar is upstairs.
Let people look through the seasonal menu before they come.
Show the room, hours and price, and take a message without a booking system.

features.title: A little above the usual
features.text: The hero gives the neighborhood, the floor and the way up before anything else.
features.story: People miss the door, so the first screen says it's upstairs, above happy's, with the address under the headline. Two buttons go to the menu or to the visit details.

features.title: Menu, glass by glass
features.text: The seasonal Fall / Winter 2026 list, with a tab for planning and ingredients one tap away.
features.story: The menu changes often and guests order at the counter, so there's no cart. Tapping an item adds it to a tally for planning a round. Tapping a glass shows its ingredients, one drink at a time, and the page says plainly the drawings aren't recipes.

features.title: The room
features.text: Four photos: the bar, the upper lounge, the menu at the bar and the lounge seating.
features.story: Exposed brick, timber beams and plants are the draw, so the room gets real photos with short captions instead of a description.

features.title: Reviews
features.text: A section for what guests say.

features.title: Hours, details and a message form
features.text: Address, hours, seating, price range, directions, and a contact form.
features.story: Hours are plain text. The sign-up and the message form go through Netlify Forms, with a consent checkbox on the email list and a note that the form doesn't book tables or place orders.

features.title: On a phone
features.text: The hero, menu and room on a phone.
